What is Chapter 2 mainly about?: Is direction the same as position?
No. Direction is the way something points or moves.

What is Chapter 2 mainly about?: Is “to the right of starting position” the clean way to describe direction?
No. Say “to the right” or “in the positive x-direction.”

What is Chapter 2 mainly about?: What is the clean way to describe velocity direction?
Say the speed and the direction, such as “15 m/s to the right.”
